opening.argument: The presentation frames Forsage as a participation and business opportunity built around numbered matrices, requiring three people for the project and directing viewers to activate with $155, recruit webinar attendees, register, and share with friends. It claims that when the program activates using $155, $155 will be transferred immediately as 100% income, while also citing monthly returns. That combination of tiered participation, recruitment, and promised transfers establishes the central offer. The visible dashboard and supplied directions provide related context, but they do not verify that transfers occurred, that the stated returns were realized, or that the platform’s full terms were disclosed.
